governanceBaseline.existingRule: Same-date stock rows are clustered samples, not independent experiments.
governanceBaseline.incrementalContrastCoverage: V8.7.8 leave-one-date-out applies to I01-I07 partial-correlation contrasts, not automatically to R04/R07 grouped return summaries.

R04.classification: Within each scanDate, median split into HIGH/LOW.
R04.aggregation: Each stock return is appended into a global HIGH or LOW array across all dates, then counterfactualMetricStats is computed on raw rows.
R04.problem: Dates with more usable Shadow rows receive more weight.

R07.classification: Within each scanDate, medians split residual strength and attention into four quadrants.
R07.aggregation: Each stock D5 return is appended into global quadrant arrays, then raw-row statistics are computed.
R07.problem: Date contribution is proportional to number of qualifying rows/quadrant assignments.

R08.primaryPaired: For each date and horizon, mean(QUIET)-mean(ATTENTION) is computed first; those date deltas are aggregated.
R08.secondaryByEngine: byEngine return/MFE/MAE summaries are raw-row weighted and therefore descriptive only.
R08.conclusion: Do not downgrade R08 paired solely for this date-weighting issue; other cohort/outcome-provenance guards still apply.

fixedSyntheticWitness.conclusion: Unequal row counts can reverse the sign of the cross-date grouped mean even though each scanDate should be one independent unit.

R04_V1_1.classification: Keep the frozen within-date median split.
R04_V1_1.primary: For each clean date with both HIGH and LOW, compute mean(HIGH D5)-mean(LOW D5); aggregate date deltas with equal date weight.
R04_V1_1.secondary: Report equal-date HIGH mean and equal-date LOW mean separately; raw-row means may remain descriptive.

R07_V1_1.classification: Keep the frozen within-date residual-strength/attention median split.
R07_V1_1.primary: For each clean date with both QUIET_STRENGTH and ATTENTION_STRENGTH, compute their mean D5 difference; aggregate equally by date.
R07_V1_1.secondary: Four-quadrant equal-date group means and coverage; raw-row quadrant means remain descriptive.

R08.primary: Retain existing paired date-delta implementation for D5/D10/D20.
R08.guard: Treat byEngine raw-row summaries as descriptive context, not the primary effect estimate.

readinessGuard: Having >=60 rows and >=15 dates is coverage readiness, not proof the displayed raw-row mean respects the scanDate inference unit.
R04/R07 directional interpretation must use date-level contrasts before promotion-grade review.
Dates lacking both compared groups do not receive a fabricated zero or cross-date substitute.
Do not add industry/channel matching in this repair; that would create new degrees of freedom and requires separate preregistration.
All existing cohort-quality and outcome-provenance guards remain upstream prerequisites.
